subject: Northstar latency surge / closure plan and exec readout
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@northstar.ai>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Northstar Tech Ops <ops@northstar.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Unacceptable latency spike this morning — help needed

Rafael,

We hit a significant latency and error-rate spike in our production integration with Redwood between 08:40–09:05 EDT this morning. Token delays averaged ~1.2s and a subset of requests returned 5xx errors — duration and error patterns are in the attached sample telemetry. This impacted our real-time analytics pipelines and caused downstream timeouts.

Can you explain root cause and what immediate mitigations you can apply? Northstar is evaluating failover plans; our execs have asked for an incident summary and a mitigation timeline within 24 hours.

Priya
Head of Integrations
Northstar Analytics

[Attachment: northstar-telemetry-sample.csv]

From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@northstar.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T09:35:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Unacceptable latency spike this morning — help needed

Priya — thanks for the heads up and for the telemetry. I’m sorry for the impact.

Immediate next steps from our side (first 3 hours):
- We’ve pinned a high-priority on-call team to the case (Grace + Vivek) and are taking a live sample to reproduce the spike.
- Triage shows a sudden shift in prefix cache hit-rate for your workload and several long-lived KV-cache entries being evicted around 08:38. We’re running a full scrub and will push a targeted cache-protection policy if confirmed.
- I’ll set up an exec readout at 16:00 EDT today (we can adjust). Please let me know if that works for your leadership.

Can you confirm whether any new query patterns or batch imports started on your side around 08:15–08:45?

Rafael
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415-555-0129

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T10:02:00-04:00
Subject: RE: Unacceptable latency spike this morning — help needed

Quick internal summary:
- Observed pattern: sudden drop in KV cache hit-rate for customer namespace ns_northstar; simultaneous 20% increase in long-tail sequence lengths from 2 specific API keys.
- Hypothesis: a backlog of warm requests triggered cache churn; combined with an edge routing flapping condition on us-west-2 we saw elevated queueing.
- Mitigation applied: bumped cache TTL for ns_northstar and temporarily pinned their routing to dedicated warm hosts to prevent cross-tenant eviction.
- Metrics: by 09:55 EDT token latency 95p dropped from 1.2s -> 180ms; error rate reduced to baseline.

Action owner list (short):
- Grace: continue telemetry correlation and produce timeline
- Vivek: supervise routing pin + measure cost delta of pinned hosts
- Marissa: prepare draft RCA for execs

Laura
Senior Product Ops, Redwood

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@northstar.ai>, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T11:18:00-04:00
Subject: Timeline + sample traces attached

Priya — attaching per-request traces with span-level timings and the request IDs that experienced 5xx. The root cause appears to be an interaction between a sudden increase in 1) long sequence streaming requests and 2) a GC cycle on older warm hosts leading to transient KV eviction. We have the exact host IDs and span traces in Drive.

TL;DR: not a model decode bug; infra-level cache churn + routing flapping amplified with your traffic pattern.

Next: we will: 1) propose a permanent route isolation for your top keys, 2) add a protective pre-warm for long-sequence jobs, 3) deliver an RCA doc by EOD tomorrow.

[Drive link: /Shared/Northstar/Traces/2026-10-25]

Grace
SRE — Redwood

From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@northstar.ai>, Mark Johnson <mjohnson@northstar.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-27T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Northstar post-incident summary (draft) and corrective action tracker

Priya / Mark —

Attached is our draft RCA (summary + technical timeline) and an action tracker with owners and ETA. High-level summary:
- Incident window: 2026-10-25T08:37–09:05 EDT
- Primary drivers: KV-cache eviction caused by cache churn on warm hosts + routing instability in us-west-2; amplified by long-streaming sequences from a small set of API keys.
- Immediate mitigations taken: TTL bump + host pinning + temporary route isolation (reduced cross-tenant eviction).
- Planned medium-term changes: dedicated warm pools for Northstar, adaptive pre-warm on long sequences, and routing stability fixes by our infra team (target 2 weeks).

Action tracker highlights (attached):
- Dedicated warm pool (owner: Vivek) — ETA 2026-11-10
- Adaptive pre-warm logic (owner: Grace) — ETA 2026-11-03
- Routing fallback hardening (owner: Laura) — ETA 2026-11-04
- Customer-facing credit discussion (owner: Rafael) — scheduled with Finance and Legal

We’ve included a cost impact assessment for the pinned hosts and a suggested credit range as a starting point. Please review and share any legal/compliance constraints, Mark.

Attachments: northstar-rca-draft-20261027.pdf, followup-action-tracker.xlsx

Rafael
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Mark Johnson <mjohnson@northstar.ai>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@northstar.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-28T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar post-incident summary (draft) and corrective action tracker

Rafael — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear action plan. A few items from Legal/Procurement side:
- Please include a short summary of monitoring changes we can consume in our SLO dashboard (we need proof that commits are in place before procurement signs off on expanded reserved capacity).
- On credits: Northstar expects a formal credit proposal. Your suggested range is fine as a starting point but we’ll need the final amount in writing.
- One ask from our execs: an optional 30-minute readout next week with infra + product to validate the mitigation plan. Can we schedule Mon 11/2 or Tue 11/3 mornings PST?

We’ll review the RCA PDF and action tracker; please circulate the final versions and mark completed items as you finish them.

Mark Johnson
VP Legal & Ops
Northstar Analytics
